head: pan
notes: AMK B-11143 (#8 x 3/8 Phillips pan tapping screw, 'BT' point) lists OEM 9422245. Found only as a search snippet (amkproducts.com 403). Another AMK snippet calls B-11143 '#8 X 3/8 PH PN TEK ZC' (zinc), so finish/point is uncertain. First-pass camaros.net note said it wasn't in AMK's catalog; AMK's current listing does have it. 1968 Camaro AIM lists 9422245 SCREW (no size); camaros.net poster says it is not in AMK catalog. Companion screw 3849634 is 8-18 x 5/8 but that is not a size for 9422245.
